overview: Track ICP neuron staking rewards and maturity growth over time with daily snapshots, governance sync, and portfolio stats.
features: Track multiple ICP neurons with names, dissolve delay, and initial stake
Daily reward snapshots with automatic delta computation
Sync maturity from the NNS governance canister
Portfolio summary with total staked, rewards, and percentage return
Maturity growth line chart per neuron
Activity feed timeline distinguishing growth from disburse/spawn events
Manual snapshot entry as fallback when hotkey is not configured
